what: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol through aelix's own openai-codex provider and the owner's aelix login, as gpt-5.6-sol (owner decision 2026-10-21 on Issue #23: the Q17-b agent of the updated OpenAI model; aelix 0.1.0b2's catalog does not list it, so models.json adds it to the built-in provider)

auth.what: the owner's ChatGPT login stored by aelix's /login (OpenAI Codex) in aelix's own credential store, ~/.aelix/agent/auth.json by default; aelix reads and refreshes it in place through tools/model_eval_aelix.py, the harness never opens it

serving.endpoint: https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses (aelix 0.1.0b2 built-in provider openai-codex: models.json gives the model no api or baseUrl, so aelix takes the provider's, openai-codex-responses and https://chatgpt.com/backend-api; models_json.parse_models)
serving.snapshot: none: no dated snapshot is named (2026-10-21)
serving.tokenizer: not published: counts come from the backend's usage only
serving.listed: not in aelix 0.1.0b2's models_generated.json (2026-10-21); listed through this models.json entry
serving.catalog: the Codex CLI 0.162.0 model list of the owner's ChatGPT login (~/.codex/models_cache.json, fetched 2026-10-21): gpt-6.1-sol, context_window 500,000 (max_context_window 872,000), input text and image, reasoning levels low to ultra. The output reservation 128,000 is gpt-5.6-sol's in aelix's catalog: the Codex list gives none
serving.reasoning: thinking medium: aelix sends reasoning {effort: medium, summary: auto}, as for gpt-5.6-sol (aelix 0.1.0b2's default level)
serving.request: aelix's codex body: instructions = the system prompt, store false, stream true, text.verbosity low, include reasoning.encrypted_content, tool_choice auto, parallel_tool_calls true, tools with strict null, prompt_cache_key = the session id (cache retention short); aelix sends no sampling values
serving.billing: the ChatGPT subscription of the login; the cost row is 0 because no API price is configured for this entry
serving.usage: openai-codex-responses reads the backend's usage with the shared Responses engine: aelix records input = input_tokens - cached_tokens, cache_read = cached_tokens, reasoning = output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens (0 when absent; a subset of output), cache_write written 0 without reading
